setlist.title: Going Down the Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' in the Band** (2 reviews): After returning to the main theme, Garcia plays an exceptionally high peak; Longest version played up to then, sounding more like 1974 [7][9]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): Comes across a little lumpy compared with the rest of the show; Guitar sounds odd, Garcia sings with feeling, and the band fades the ending out together [6][7]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Contains a tease that leads into Going Down the Road Feeling Bad; Singled out as a particularly good version [13][15]
- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): The Truckin' into Morning Dew jam appeared, edited, on the Europe '72 album; Leads into the well-known Other One and Morning Dew jam in the second set [6][8]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Its appearance in the first set was a surprise [9]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Played well and sounds and feels good [5]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): McNally's book describes Garcia playing facing away from the crowd, in tears, as the song began [13]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Central jam mixes slowed psychedelic Dead with single-drummer jazz fusion in a Miles Davis style [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Two Souls in Communion**: rare: 10 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd72-05-26.sbd.hollister.12758.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 244 min; rated 4.82/5 by 55 [1]. Said about its sound: Sounds good, especially considering how many generations separate it from the master [5]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.smith.94452.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 237 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.waddell.89641.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 222 min; rated 4.24/5 by 17 [4]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.mvernon.5931.shnf**: soundboard; 31 songs; 214 min; rated 5/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- It was the band's final night in Europe, played with high energy and finesse [6]
- The first set runs to nineteen songs [7]
- A lot of tuning happens between first-set songs [8]
- The first set contains nineteen songs [9]
- One of a handful of shows suited to play for listeners who don't know the Dead [11]
- The Other One here rivals the Amsterdam performance from 5/10 [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-05-26.sbd.hollister.12758.sbeok.shnf**: source: S:MR> DATx5> CD, including patches (see info file for specifics [1]. Also: Soundboard master reel transferred to DAT, then CD, with patches; transfer by David Hollister [1]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.smith.94452.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matt Smith, Jamie Waddell, and Evan K.; source: SBD > Master Reel (film crew feed) at 7 1/2 i.p.s. [2]. Also: Original discs supplied by Matt Smith; Cuts in Cumberland Blues, set two tuning and Morning Dew were patched from other existing sources [2]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.waddell.89641.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Todd Evans; source: SBD Reel > DAT [4]. Also: Upgrade of earlier circulating versions; Cumberland Blues and set two tuning come from shnid 12758; DAT transfer contained most of Morning Dew; the missing portion was patched; shared by Todd Evans [4]
- **gd1972-05-26.sbd.mvernon.5931.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Master SBD reel > DAT > CD-R >EAC > CDR [3]
